description.en: Plugins published by Anlerway for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Anlerway 发布给 DeepSeek Harness 的插件。

description.en: Resource-manager style session browser for DSH: virtual folders, tags, notes, trash and multi-workspace browsing.
description.zh: 资源管理器式的会话浏览器：虚拟文件夹、标签、备注、回收站、多 workspace 浏览，从不改动 ~/.dsh 的物理布局。
